news.title: Davis Hartwell Closes With A 68 To Highlight Beavers On Last Day Of The Bryson
news.desc: MIAMI – Davis Hartwell closed with a 4-under 68, the best round by a Beaver on the final day, as Oregon State finished ninth at The Bryson Wednesday.

news.title: Oregon State TV Schedule Announced
news.desc: CORVALLIS – Oregon State's 2026-27 TV games and game times were announced Wednesday, in conjunction with the Pac-12 Conference.
